sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as the root of the power of action is superior to all other soul-powers, so too in divine service action is the primary virtue, with study being great only because it leads to action, and in the future action will be great in a higher sense, reaching the essential concealment.

translations.translation: e)
And behold, just as in the powers of the soul the root of the power of action is above the root of all the powers,
so too is it in the service of Havayah,
that the primary virtue is specifically in action.
For that "study is great"22
is only now,
but in the future, action will be great23.
And even now, that study is great,
the reason for this is that study brings to action24,
for from this it is proven that the main thing is action25.
And that in the future specifically action will be great is because in the superiority of action over study there are two general aspects26
[analogous to the two aspects mentioned above in section d regarding the superiority of the power of action over the other powers].
One is that action arouses and draws down the light of the boundless [bLi gvul] that is above its enclothing in wisdom
(study),
therefore the drawing down through action is to a lower level.
And the other is that action reaches the essential concealment,
which is above even the light of the boundless [bLi gvul].
And it can be said,
that the superiority of action now
(that even now the main thing is action,
and the greatness of study is that it brings to action,
as above)
is this: that through action there is a drawing down of the light of the boundless [bLi gvul],
perfection in the matter of revelations.
And this is "great is study that brings to action,"
that this superiority of action is included in the greatness of study.
For that the drawing down of study is in a manner that brings to action,
that the drawing down comes to a lower level,
this is the greatness of study,
that the light of the boundless [bLi gvul] is drawn into it, through which it is drawn downward and brings to action.
And that in the future action will be great is the elevation of the action itself,
that it reaches the essential concealment which is above revelations.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section discusses Chanukah's superior illumination from beyond the chain of descent, which transforms darkness itself, and contrasts the eighth day of Chanukah (refining the lower) with the eighth day of the consecration (drawing down from above).

translations.translation: f)
And behold, it is known27
that on Chanukah,
after the strengthening of the darkness of the Greeks,
there was a drawing down more elevated than the drawing down that was in the Holy Temple before this,
for regarding the drawing down that was beforehand, it was possible for the strengthening of the darkness of the Greeks to occur,
and the drawing down of Chanukah is from Havayah that is above the chain of descent,
this light illuminates even the darkness,
and "Havayah"
(with the addition of a vav)
"will illuminate my darkness"28,
that the darkness itself shines29,
in the manner of the revelation of the future30.
And based on this, we can explain the difference between the eighth day of Chanukah and the eighth day of the consecration [of the Mishkan],
that this that the eighth of the consecration is in Malchus
(the eighth that is below the seven)
is that the drawing down from above was drawn down until Malchus,
and this that the eighth of Chanukah is in Malchus is that through the drawing down of Chanukah there is an elevation in Malchus itself.
And this is that in the discourses that explain the matter of the eight days of the consecration, two interpretations of "eighth" are brought
(that it is above the seven and that it is below the seven),
and in the aforementioned discourse that explains the matter of the eighth of Chanukah, only the interpretation that the eighth is below the seven is brought,
because this that the drawing down from above is drawn down even to the lower
(the eighth of the consecration)
is due to the superiority of the root of the drawing down
(similar to the superiority of action now),
the eighth that is above the seven31.
And the power for there to be refinement and elevation in the lower itself
(the eighth of Chanukah)
is from the essential concealment that is above the root of revelation
(similar to32
the great action that will be in the future).
And therefore the emphasis of the eighth day of Chanukah is that it is in Malchus
[which is why it is called "this is Chanukah"],
the matter of refining the lower33.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation that in the future action will be great was specifically revealed in the later generations to spur greater effort in action now, thereby bringing about that future greatness.

translations.translation: g)
And behold, this matter that in the future action will be great was revealed
(like all matters of Chassidus)
specifically in the later generations.
And the reason they revealed this to us
(even though now the halachah is that study is great),
is,
because all revelations of the future depend on our actions and service now34.
And that in the future action will be great is through the effort and alacrity in the matter of action now.
And therefore in the generation of the heels of Moshiach they revealed that in the future action will be great,
in order to thereby arouse even more effort and alacrity in the matter of action,
and through this, in the future there will be great action.
